feedback.temperature_assumption: The -40..85C range is resistor temperature, not just distant ambient; self-heating/board heating remains to be checked.
feedback.aging_scope: Matches TNPW GENERAL mode8000h0.1% rating, not unlimited lifetime or combined environmental-stress qualification. GENERAL0603P70=0.110W; divider dissipation is far below it.
feedback.independent_method: Enumerated16 corners using multiplicative initial tolerance/TCR/aging factors; additionally formed conservative min with maximum top-resistor bias-current drop.
feedback.cross_term_finding: PASS. Despite additive error accumulation, original symmetric bounds are slightly wider than independent multiplicative envelope for these values. No correction needed.
feedback.ifb_scope: Treating IFB as±100nA is a conservative project model. TI table gives100nA maximum, not an explicit symmetric±100nA limit.
feedback.current_finding: 49.3355uA is correct at3.300V. Actual idealVFB0.500V gives3.307692V and49.4505uA. Neither number includes conversion efficiency/PFM system quiescent draw.

bq_original_arithmetic.status: PASS as initial-resistor-tolerance-only arithmetic; not all-temperature/lifetime bounds.
bq_original_arithmetic.charge_timer_behavior: Correctly recognizes DPPM/VIN-DPM/thermal-regulation proportional timer slowing. Thermal shutdown suspends timer. Q/I is only an ideal capacity/current quotient, not a CC/CV time guarantee.
bq_original_arithmetic.charging_decision: PASS: keep R108 DNP and charging disabled. User7555704000mAh screenshot does not supply charge current/temperature or NTC curve, and old297mA+68kohm timer is not qualified.

supplemental_bq_temperature_bounds.recommendation: Adopt these thermal resistor bounds or label existing values initial-tolerance-only. Do not extrapolate the BQ table guarantee to negative junction temperature. Resistor aging, soldering drift and actual temperature still need qualification if lifetime guarantees are intended.

user_component_scope.conclusion: 2A room-temperature seller continuous rating supports only an initial budget. The1.5A main-rail pulse plus audio estimate exceeds2A; keep bench-source-only until pack pulse/protection data and measurements are available.

findings.summary: Original ILIM/ISET/TMR endpoints include initial±1% but omit selected100ppm resistors. Add explicit temperature scope or supplemental bounds; selection remains viable.
Original additive resistor-error PWM interval is slightly more conservative than independent multiplicative corner interval. Earlier provisional concern resolved.
Pack charge/NTC data and actual CC/CV profile are still absent; never interpret timer arithmetic as charge approval.
